cases.title: Two Gateways racing on one key create one invocation
cases.when: Two Gateway replicas submit the same tool, namespace identity and business key at the same instant, 100 times
then: Exactly one NEW per round; the other caller gets EXISTING for the same invocationId
control_business_keys has one row per round
The tool executes once per round

cases.title: A repeat with the same fingerprint returns the original
cases.when: The same caller repeats a completed call with the same key and arguments
then: EXISTING with the original result
No new invocation row, permit or execution

cases.title: A repeat while running returns IN_PROGRESS to a client without Tasks
cases.when: The same caller repeats while the first invocation is EXECUTING, without the Tasks extension
then: Retryable IN_PROGRESS error
With the Tasks extension: the original task

cases.title: Different arguments under one key conflict
cases.when: The same caller reuses a key with different arguments
then: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
The original result is never returned

cases.title: The fingerprint holds exactly the specified fields
cases.when: Repeat with each of argumentsDigest, package major, resolved effect class, catalog scope kind and (AGENT, TENANT) userId changed in turn
then: Each change gives IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE
Changing only the package minor version gives EXISTING
The namespace identity is not part of the fingerprint

cases.title: Another identity learns nothing from a key in use
cases.when: Another agent (TENANT) or the same agent for another user (AGENT) reuses the key, with matching and non-matching fingerprints
then: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE in both cases with byte-identical bodies
No invocation id, task id, result, status or timestamp
Median latency of the two cases differs by less than 5% over 1,000 calls
Audit records both callers

cases.title: A user's second agent sees the original only if authorised now
cases.when: In DELEGATED_USER, agent B repeats agent A's call for the same user and fingerprint, once with the tool granted to B and once without
then: Granted: EXISTING through B's catalog scope check
Not granted: the same 403 an unknown tool gets

cases.title: TENANT results are shared only when approved
cases.when: A different caller repeats a TENANT-namespace call with the same fingerprint, with shareResultsWithinTenant false and true
then: false: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE
true: EXISTING
Audit records both callers in both cases

cases.title: DELEGATED_USER refuses SERVICE callers
cases.when: A SERVICE-mode caller calls a DELEGATED_USER tool with a key
then: BUSINESS_KEY_NAMESPACE_MISMATCH
No reservation row

cases.title: The namespace identity never comes from arguments
cases.when: Arguments carry agentId, userId and tenantId fields that differ from the authenticated caller
then: The reservation uses the authenticated identities
The constraint key ignores the argument values

cases.title: Constraint, fingerprint, forwarded value and retention use one namespace
cases.when: One call per namespace AGENT, DELEGATED_USER and TENANT with an upstream that records Idempotency-Key
then: Constraint row key matches the namespace table
Forwarded value is a.<agentIdHash>.<key>, u.<userIdHash>.<key> or the raw key
Retention and tombstone use businessKeyRetention for that namespace

cases.title: A missing key follows the tool policy
cases.when: A requiresBusinessKey tool is called without a key under REJECT, ASK and ALLOW_WITH_DEDUPE
then: REJECT: an error naming the missing key, nothing runs
ASK: an approval is created and nothing runs before it
ALLOW_WITH_DEDUPE: a repeat inside dedupeWindow returns EXISTING; after it, NEW

cases.title: A reused key past retention never creates a second operation
cases.when: A key is reused after its result was purged and only the tombstone remains
then: EXPIRED_KEY
Policy rejects by default or routes to ASK
No new invocation is created silently

cases.title: A key rebinds only after a not-started end
cases.when: A key is reused after its invocation ended EXPIRED before consume, FAILED with notStarted, REJECTED and COMPLETED
then: EXPIRED before consume and FAILED notStarted: NEW, rebinding the key
REJECTED: never rebound
COMPLETED: EXISTING

cases.title: Tools needing a reservation fail closed when the store is down
cases.when: The state database is unavailable and a requiresBusinessKey tool is called
then: A retryable error
Nothing executes unreserved

cases.title: The broker credential matches the namespace
cases.when: Calls in each cell of the credential ownership table, plus a SERVICE call to a tool bound to a user-scoped secret
then: Allowed cells succeed
Rejected cells fail at review or enable
A user-scoped account is looked up by the permit userId, never an argument
A SERVICE call never uses a user-scoped credential
